## A tidier sidebar

This release changes nothing about what is measured, only how the sidebar reads. The machine name now sits centered on its status dot, the faulted-state diamond is sized to read the same as the dot, and the "how to add another machine" hint is a proper footnote with a heading instead of a wall of text.

**Tests.** The full suite stays green on Windows and Linux, with only the usual platform-specific skips.
